android.desc:
This app shows you all the important dates of your friends and family at a glance.

Better than your digital calendar:
In your normal calendar app, it’s easy to lose track of events like birthdays and anniversaries due to all the other appointments and entries. Our app simplifies everything – and lets you manage recurring events comfortably without the noise.

Better than your paper calendar:
The app automatically calculates your friends’ age, shows their Western and Chinese zodiac signs, and lets you know which day of the week each person’s next birthday is. In addition to that, you will always know exactly how many days are left until each of your friends’ and family’s important dates.

Easy to use and reliable:
Adding a new birthday or anniversary takes just a few seconds. Add your entries once – and benefit in all the years to come. This personal calendar will do the work for you in the future. It does what you want, and nothing else.

Notifications and reminders:
Let the app remind you of all the important events related to your family and friends, so that you will never forget a birthday or anniversary again. Get reminded on the day of the event, at your preferred time of the day, or even on the days before, if you wish to be reminded in advance. This ensures you will still have time to prepare a party, find the perfect gift, or just make time to see or call your friend.

Sending wishes and congratulations:
Easily send your best wishes and congratulations to your friends right from this app – via call, text message, email or messenger app.

Powerful search:
Search your complete list of birthdays, anniversaries and other important dates – either by name, age or year of birth. Finding the important events of your friends and family has never been easier.

Beyond birthdays:
This calendar works for birthdays, anniversaries and other important dates, like days of death, jubilees or wedding days, or just any type of countdown.

Saving notes:
For every individual person and event, you can save notes right in the app, e.g. to remember the great gift idea you just had, or the artist or book your friend recently mentioned.

Backups for safety:
Create backups of all your entries, either to the storage of your device or right to your second device.

Widgets on your home screen:
Place a list of your upcoming events right on your home screen, with one of our widgets in different sizes and designs.

Permissions:
• Contacts: for disp
